task.pr_title: fix(datetime): values are adjusted to be in bounds

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
Playing around with this made me notice something. Say you have a datetime with a `min` of 5/1 at 8AM. You select a value of 5/3 at 4:30AM. You then click on 5/1. With the current logic, because the hour and minute are handled separately, the time is auto-adjusted to 8:30AM.

This feels strange to me; from a user perspective, I would expect the time to go to the min (8AM), since that's the closest possible time to my selection. Maybe the times should be compared as a whole instead? (This would also apply to the `max` logic below.)

evidence.thread_resolution: liamdebeasi: Good point 👍  I changed this in https://github.com/ionic-team/ionic-framework/pull/26125/commits/0f7db03f203dcafd0bf9539c4741522ccea0ca76.
